checks: Two new accounts create their own valid heroes through the existing revision-checked save endpoint.
Cancel preserves the disposable hero; confirmed deletion clears only its slot; retry is idempotent; other account/slots unchanged.
Stale deletion and stale save cannot overwrite the replacement hero.
Mixed boss eligibility awards only the unclaimed chest; full inventory retains pending equipment; both accounts restore their own reward histories.
Active hero deletion is blocked; departure saves and remaining-hero saves still succeed.
scope: Only newly generated disposable accounts. No existing player accounts accessed or changed. No credentials recorded.
